primaryChecks.text: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 1:43 はEdomを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
primaryChecks.previousContext: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
primaryChecks.nextContext: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 「Edomのchiefs」は人々の首長列挙であり、土地名としてではない。

primaryChecks.text: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
primaryChecks.previousContext: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 直前から続く「chiefs of Edom」の人々の列挙であり、土地名としての用例ではない。

primaryChecks.text: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
primaryChecks.previousContext: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 18:11 はEdomを地理的な対象として明記する。

primaryChecks.text: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 18:13 はEdomを地理的な対象として明記する。
